verdict.rationale: Corporations Canada's own fees page publishes exact dollar amounts per transaction and channel: $200 for online incorporation, $100 extra for 4-hour express service, $250 by email or mail, $200 for amendments and $250 for an exemption. These are shown alongside processing times, not hidden behind a contact form. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the published amounts, and fee amounts for other recurring transactions such as the annual return.

support.subject: As a founder, the exact statutory fees for my transaction are published on the service's own pages — amounts, not a contact form

citations.quote: Add $100 for express service in 4 hours.
Email or mail It will cost $250 and will take 10 days.
These amendments will cost $200 and will take 1 day.
Apply for an exemption ... It will cost $250 and will take 30 days.
